paragraphs: I'm Sairam — Sai to most people, a final-year computer science student at PES University, currently interning at [WSAI](https://wsai.iitm.ac.in/) under [Prof. Krishna Pillutla](https://krishnap25.github.io/), working on differential privacy for machine learning.

I like problems where something breaks in an interesting way and the interesting part is figuring out exactly why. That's shown up across causal inference, quantization, and optimizer design, usually the same move: name the failure precisely, show why it happens, then check it empirically.

Outside of research: I was a teaching assistant for Mathematics for Computer Science at PES, and I picked up the Dr. MR Doreswamy and CN Rao merit scholarships along the way. I gave a lightning talk at WSAI, IIT Madras earlier this year.

publications.title: The Final-Stage Bottleneck: A Systematic Dissection of the R-Learner for Network Causal Inference

projects.title: The Geometry of Bit-Collapse: Quantization Instability
bullets: Investigated geometric failure modes of Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) on ResNet-18 / CIFAR-10 using a custom Hessian Spectrum Visualizer (PyHessian, averaged over 40 batches for variance reduction).
Diagnosed "Bit-Collapse": Int8 quantization sharply narrows the loss basin and triggers spectral eigenvalue spikes, destabilizing standard SGD training regimes.

Demonstrated that SAM fully restores geometric stability under quantization, recovering a flatter loss basin than the FP32 baseline — suggesting SAM as a principled mitigation for quantization-induced sharpness.

projects.title: Reproducibility Study: The SAM Optimizer
bullets: Implemented a clean-room version of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ICLR 2021) from first principles, manually engineering the dual-step perturbation-ascent / gradient-descent logic via explicit gradient normalization.

Reproduced Wide-ResNet / CIFAR-10 accuracy (~96% vs. the paper's ~97%), then identified a structural gap in the original formulation: SAM implicitly outsources model-complexity regularization to weight decay, leaving it unaccounted for in the perturbation objective.

Characterized a failure regime: the second-order gradient approximation degrades precisely at sharp minima — the regime SAM is designed to escape — revealing a theoretical tension in the algorithm's core assumption.

projects.title: A First-Principles Dissection of Optimization Pathologies
bullets: Built a NumPy-based Hessian geometry engine to compute and visualize 2D loss landscapes (Rosenbrock, Beale), diagnosing the oscillatory failure mode of vanilla SGD in high-curvature valleys.
Analytically demonstrated how momentum dampens gradient noise via exponential averaging, accelerating convergence in ill-conditioned optimization basins.

projects.title: Reverse-Mode AutoDiff Engine
bullets: Architected a scalar-valued autograd engine from scratch, implementing reverse-mode automatic differentiation via local gradient accumulation on dynamically constructed DAGs with topological sort.
Verified numerical correctness against PyTorch to < 10⁻⁶ precision across composite differentiable functions, building ground-up intuition for backpropagation mechanics.
